description: This source file defines data structures and functions for discovering wide-area gateways using DNS service discovery (DNS-SD) and Tailscale status information. It includes logic for DNS querying, parsing TXT and SRV records, and managing discovery context.

classes.name: WideAreaGatewayBeacon
classes.description: Represents a discovered wide-area gateway with attributes such as name, host, ports, and optional attributes.

classes.name: DiscoveryContext
classes.description: Contains the closure-based context for performing discovery, including status and dig functions.

methods.name: discover
methods.description: Main discovery function that returns a list of detected wide-area gateway beacons within a specified timeout.

methods.name: collectTailnetIPv4s
methods.description: Extracts IPv4 addresses associated with the tailnet from Tailscale status JSON.

methods.name: readTailscaleStatus
methods.description: Executes command-line calls to fetch the current Tailscale status in JSON format.

methods.name: loadWideAreaPtrRecords
methods.description: Performs DNS PTR record queries to discover wide-area gateways in the specified domain.

methods.name: runDig
methods.description: Runs DNS dig command with provided arguments and timeout.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes an external process with arguments and enforces a timeout.

methods.name: parseSrv
methods.description: Parses the output of a DNS SRV query into hostname and port.

methods.name: parseTxtTokens
methods.description: Parses TXT record responses into tokens, handling DNS escape sequences.

methods.name: unescapeTxt
methods.description: Decodes string escape sequences in TXT record tokens.

methods.name: mapTxt
methods.description: Converts TXT tokens into key-value pairs.

methods.name: parseInt
methods.description: Converts string to integer if possible, trimming whitespace.

methods.name: isTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Checks if a string represents an IPv4 address within the tailnet IP range.

methods.name: decodeDnsSdEscapes
methods.description: Decodes DNS-SD escape sequences in TXT record values.
